product.description: Seria bdquo;Fetele din Fortuneldquo; Speracirc;nd să scape de ruină, Devon Sheridan, chipeșul conte de Huntingdon, este hotăracirc;t să iși găsească o nevastă bogată, cu care să se insoare din interes, nu din dragoste ndash; mai ales că primul mariaj l-a lăsat cu inima fracirc;ntă. Domnișoara Georgina Pierce, fiica unui american instărit, pare alegerea perfectă pentru scopul lui. Dar firea pasională a inocentei sale soții il ia prin surprindere și il face să viseze la zilele ndash; și mai ales la nopțile ndash; pe care le vor petrece impreună... pacirc;nă cacirc;nd descoperă șocat că averea promisă a fost risipită de patima socrului său pentru jocurile de noroc. Deși soția lui neagă vehement că ar fi știut ceva despre acest lucru, Huntingdon se simte inșelat și profund dezamăgit.Pătimașa Georgina a fost ea insăși uluită cacirc;nd a acceptat să se mărite cu contele, un bărbat pe care abia il cunoscuse, doar pentru a-i face pe plac tatălui ei. Frumosul aristocrat nu ii ascunde că pentru el totul este doar o afacere ndash; ii oferă titlul de contesă in schimbul moștenirii ei. Dar din clipa in care valsează pentru prima dată in brațele lui, Georgina iși dă seama că va putea să-i ofere și inima acestui lord bacirc;ntuit de trecut... Mai intacirc;i insă, trebuie să-l invețe, cu răbdare, că in viață există ceva mult mai important decacirc;t banii, poziția socială și respectarea regulilor inaltei societăți ndash; și anume dragostea. Lorraine Heath a scris peste 60 de romane de dragoste, care au apărut in mod constant pe lista de bestselleruri a USA Today și New York Times. Icirc;n plus, cărțile sale au fost recompensate cu numeroase premii, printre care RITA Award, Romantic Times Reviewers' Choice Award și Career Achievement Award.

# How to Marry an Heiress: A Romance of Wealth, Desire, and Destiny

Step into a world where fortunes are made and hearts are tested. Dive into "How to Marry an Heiress," a captivating romance novel by Lorraine Heath that explores the intricate dance between societal expectations, immense wealth, and the passionate pursuit of true love. This story is more than just a tale of marriage; it is an exploration of what truly matters when you navigate the gilded cage of aristocracy and discover that the most valuable possession isn't gold, but genuine emotion.

## The Allure of Aristocracy and Ambition

The narrative centers around Devon Sheridan, a charming yet conflicted count of Huntingdon who seeks a wealthy wife to secure his future. His quest is driven by practicalityâhe desires an alliance built on financial gain rather than true affection, especially since his first marriage left him with a fractured heart. Enter Georgina Pierce, the daughter of an American industrialist, who appears to be the perfect match for Devonâs ambitious goals. On the surface, their union seems destined; however, as they begin to spend time together, a passionate fire ignites, challenging the cold calculations that initially governed their interaction.

## A Heart That Refuses to Be Bought

What unfolds is a journey where external pressures clash with internal desires. Georginaâs initial acceptance of the arranged marriage masks a deeper yearning for something more profound than mere status. As the story progresses, Devon and Georgina must confront the reality that the pursuit of wealth and social standing cannot replace the deep, undeniable connection they are developing. The novel beautifully illustrates the tension between duty and desire, showing how even the most rigidly structured society can be broken by authentic, passionate love.

## The Power of True Connection

"How to Marry an Heiress" delves deeply into the complexities of human relationships, reminding readers that true happiness is found not in material possessions or social titles, but in the vulnerability and honesty shared between two people. It follows Devonâs realization that the rules of high society are secondary to the powerful pull of his heart for Georgina. This is a story about finding courageâthe courage to defy expectations and choose love, no matter how complicated the path may seem.

## A Masterpiece by Lorraine Heath

Authored by the acclaimed Romance writer Lorraine Heath, this book draws on her extensive experience crafting emotionally rich and compelling narratives. Heath has successfully written over 60 romance novels that have consistently appeared on bestseller lists for publications like USA Today and The New York Times, earning numerous accolades including the RITA Award, Romantic Times Reviewers' Choice Award, and Career Achievement Award. Reading this title offers you access to a story filled with romantic tension, rich character development, and an ultimately satisfying exploration of enduring love.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is the main theme of this novel?**
A: The primary themes are the conflict between societal expectations and personal desires, the search for true love amidst wealth, and the journey of finding emotional fulfillment over material gain in a romantic setting.

**Q: Who is the author of this book?**
A: The novel is written by Lorraine Heath.

**Q: Is this story suitable for readers who enjoy historical romance?**
A: Yes, it is a compelling historical romance that focuses on rich settings, passionate relationships, and dramatic emotional arcs.
